task.requirement: Choose the cheapest certified carrier able to carry at least 8 crates. Return exactly carrier and cost.

cases.assumption: Capacity and lowest price determine eligibility; certification is only descriptive.

task.requirement: Use the highest revision with status approved. Draft revisions are not authoritative. Return exactly limit and revision.

cases.assumption: The numerically newest revision supersedes all older policy entries.

task.requirement: Each order is counted once, using its highest revision. Sum the resulting order amounts; return total and order_count.

cases.assumption: Each recorded row is an independent order contributing its amount.

task.requirement: Add all lengths after converting to centimeters. One meter equals 100 centimeters; one millimeter equals 0.1 centimeters. Return exactly total_cm.

cases.assumption: The recorded numeric quantities share a common centimeter scale.

task.requirement: Choose the cheapest certified carrier able to carry at least 6 crates. Return exactly carrier and cost.

cases.assumption: Amber meets both eligibility requirements and is cheapest among eligible carriers.

task.requirement: Use the highest revision with status approved. Return exactly limit and revision.

cases.assumption: Revision 2 is both approved and the highest eligible revision.

task.requirement: Each order is counted once using its highest revision. Sum those order amounts; return total and order_count.

cases.assumption: The two unique orders contribute 11 and 9, with no superseded rows.

task.requirement: Find the slot with earliest UTC finish. UTC start equals local_start_minute minus utc_offset_minutes; finish adds duration_minutes. Return exactly slot and utc_finish_minute.

cases.assumption: Both offsets are equal, and north finishes at UTC minute 460 before south at 480.

task.requirement: Choose the highest scoring applicant holding an active license for region west. License state and region are mandatory, not tie breakers. Return exactly applicant and score.

cases.assumption: Highest score is sufficient; licensing can be addressed after selection.

task.requirement: Use the highest bulletin number whose status is effective. Withdrawn bulletins are ineligible. Compute fee as units times the selected rate. Return exactly bulletin and fee.

cases.assumption: The largest bulletin number determines the current rate even after withdrawal.

task.requirement: Compute net posted revenue: posted sales add and posted refunds subtract. Pending entries contribute nothing. Return exactly net and posted_count.

cases.assumption: All recorded positive amounts add to revenue, regardless of status or entry kind.

task.requirement: Find the slot with earliest UTC finish. UTC start equals local_start_minute minus utc_offset_minutes; finish adds duration_minutes. Return exactly slot and utc_finish_minute.

cases.assumption: Comparing local finish times directly establishes which slot finishes earliest.
